item.text: The collector stops whenever the filtered item count is below `limit`, even when the gateway provides a next cursor. I’ll make the cursor authoritative for whether scanning continues and add the reported invoice case as a regression test.

The collector now continues according to `page.next`, so it can pass over filtered records without ending the scan. I’ve added the exact three-record invoice example; I’ll run the project’s test command to verify it.

item.text:
Fixed the pager to continue based on `page.next` instead of the filtered item count, so deleted rows no longer stop the invoice scan early. Added a regression test for `i-1` active, `i-2` deleted, and `i-3` active.

I couldn’t verify the tests: `node --test tests/export.test.ts` fails because Node 22 doesn’t recognize the project’s `.ts` files.
